dataset_info.summary: TEDx conference talks delivered in Spanish, segmented into utterances with their transcripts. One row is one such segment. The speech is prepared but delivered live, so it mixes fluent presentation with genuine spontaneity, applause and audience noise. Runs on this corpus are capped at 2,000 clips, drawn with a pinned seed so every fighter is scored on the same ones; a split smaller than the cap is scored in full.
dataset_info.notes: mTEDx es test split — TEDx-talk read/spontaneous speech with transcripts, same deepdml/mtedx repo family as the registered mtedx-pt-BR set.
